description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is a pivotal leadership opportunity for an RN passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for nursing staff. The facility is committed to providing high-quality rehabilitation and long-term care services to its residents.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and driving continuous improvement in patient outcomes. You will play a crucial role in staff development, quality assurance, and maintaining a positive and efficient work environment. We are looking to fill this vital role quickly with a candidate who can make an immediate impact.

This full-time position offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, based on your experience and qualifications. Join a team dedicated to making a difference in the lives of residents and their families.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Experience in a Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing SNFs
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
